title: 过去的过去

examples.en: When I got to the station, the train had left.
examples.zh: 我到车站的时候，火车已经开走了。

guess.question: “火车开走”和“我到达车站”，哪件事先发生？

options.text: 火车先开走，我到的时候它已经不在了
options.feedback: 对！先发生的事用“had + 过去分词”，这就是“过去的过去”。

options.text: 我先到车站，然后火车才开
options.feedback: 不对——那样就该说 the train left when I was there，句子里 had left 表示更早。
不对——had left 说明“开走”在“到达”之前就完成了。

rule.rule: 在过去某个时间或动作之前就已经完成的事（过去的过去）
signals: when / before / by the time 引出的过去时间
rule.formula: had + 过去分词（不分人称，所有人称都用 had）

anchors.en: When I got to the station, the train had left.
anchors.zh: 我到车站的时候，火车已经开走了。
anchors.note: 开走（更早）→ had left；到达 → got

anchors.en: By the time he was ten, he had learned 500 English words.
anchors.zh: 他十岁时就已经学了 500 个英语单词。

trap.wrong: When I got there, the train has left.
trap.right: When I got there, the train had left.
trap.why: 参照点是过去（got there），要用 had 而不是 has。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住：句子里有两个过去的动作时，更早的那个用 had + 过去分词。

options.distractor: 会议开始得更早，要用过去完成时
参照点是过去（arrived），不能用 has

check.explanation: 会议在我到达之前就开始了，用 had begun。

check.stem: She ____ (finish) her homework before her mother came back.

options.distractor: 完成作业发生在妈妈回来之前
参照点是过去，不能用 has

check.explanation: 写完作业在妈妈回来之前，是更早的动作，用 had finished。

options.text: The film had started when we got to the cinema.
The film has started when we got to the cinema.
options.distractor: 参照点是过去，要用 had

options.text: The film had start when we got to the cinema.
options.distractor: had 后面要接过去分词 started

options.text: The film was start when we got to the cinema.
options.distractor: 被动语态用错了，且时态不对

check.explanation: 电影在我们到达之前就开始，用 had started。
